description: Mines recent PR review comments, reverts, and architecture audit hits into candidate boundary, type, or test rules via /correct.
args: In ${repo_dir}, inspect recent commits, reverts, and review comments from the last 7 days, run /audit-architecture and /correct, and prepare a reviewable proposal for new .agents/boundaries.json rules, lints, or tests.
